about.hero.label: About us
about.hero.headline: Our ikigai is translating yours and lighting it up on social media with authenticity.
about.history.label: Our journey
about.history.title: Our Story
about.history.1.text: Ikigai was born from the will to do marketing for real. Tired of seeing brands treated as numbers, we decided to build an agency that understands that behind every logo there's a story worth telling.
about.history.2.text: The name Ikigai comes from the Japanese concept of "reason for being". We believe every brand has a purpose, and our job is to find it, translate it, and bring it to the digital world with authenticity and strategy.
about.history.3.text: With roots between Brazil and Japan, we combine Brazilian creativity with Japanese discipline and aesthetics to build digital strategies that truly connect brands and people.
about.team.label: The people
about.team.title: Our Team
about.team.desc: The creative and strategic minds behind every Ikigai project.
about.team.1.bio: Passionate about branding and visual storytelling. Connects strategy and creativity to give each brand an authentic voice.
about.team.2.bio: Looks after the structure and management that sustains the creativity. Makes sure every project is delivered with excellence and on time.
about.cta.title: Liked our story? Let's build yours with the same authenticity.
services.hero.label: Our services
services.hero.headline: Strategic solutions for brands that want to stand out
services.included.title: What's included
services.1.text1: We take care of your profile as if it were our own. Content planning, post creation, community management, and performance reports.
services.1.text2: We don't believe in ready-made formulas. Every brand has a voice, and our job is to find it and amplify it on social media with consistency and strategy.
services.2.text1: Your brand needs more than a pretty logo. It needs an identity that communicates who you are, what you do, and why it matters.
services.2.included.2: Tone of Voice and Strategic Language
services.3.text1: Scriptwriting, filming, and editing of short videos that capture attention in the first seconds. We create content built for the language of each platform.
services.4.text1: Real-time on-site coverage for stories that capture the energy of the moment. Ideal for events, launches, trips, and experiences.
services.4.idealForText: events, weddings, shows, workshops, launches, and trips.
services.5.text1: Strategic design combined with persuasive copy. Every visual piece is built to communicate, not just decorate. From feed to carousel, we create content that stops the scroll.
